# Promised Killua Portfolio

> Canonical URL: https://promisedkillua.sbs/
> Last updated: 2026-11-01

Promised Killua, also known as promisedkillua, nerfed_killua, and collinstheegod376, is a full-stack software engineer and Web3 / AI developer with over 10 months of intensive production experience. This website is a personal developer portfolio featuring a downloadable professional CV, production project showcases, open-source repositories, technology proficiencies, and official contact links.

## Primary topics
- Full-stack software engineering
- Frontend engineering (React 19, Next.js App Router, Vite, Tailwind CSS)
- Solana & Web3 development (@solana/web3.js, SPL tokens, Viem, on-chain analytics)
- Autonomous AI multi-agent orchestration
- Local private RAG & Chrome extensions (Manifest V3)
- Sovereign cryptographic vaults (biometric passkeys, air-gapped signing)
- High-frequency order book and tape flow boards
- Real-time multiplayer gaming architectures (WebSockets)
- Backend API and database engineering (Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Prisma)

## Technologies represented
- React & React Native
- Next.js (App Router, Server Components)

- Solana Web3 (@solana/web3.js) & Viem

## Featured Projects & Works
- Lattice Lab: https://www.latticelab.fun (Autonomous multi-agent research operating system for materials science coordinating 7 AI agents)
- SolTrace (Sol Tracer AI): https://soltracer.vercel.app (Conversational AI blockchain scanner for Solana with wallet tracking, money flow diagrams, and risk audits)
- Allpad: https://www.allpad.online (Live Solana market flow board and depth tape reader ranking top mints by 24h turnover)
- Anizuki: https://www.anizuki.sbs (Real-time multiplayer anime trivia and quiz battle arena with PIN rooms and leaderboards)
- Wheelrush: https://wheelrush.fun/ (Spin-to-win web game with virtual cash prizes and global leaderboard)
- Orvix — Solana Dev Radar: https://www.orvixagent.fun/ (Aggregates official Solana network incident reports and Agave client releases)
